## Ymaze Spontaneous Alternation Performance (YmazeSPA)

__duration: <23hours__  
Quantify daily expression of natural behaviour (single housed mice).  
 
-- __Type of data\:__ Ymaze behaviour data.  
-- __Quantification:__ Total number of each behaviour in 8h [approx 9-17].   
-- __Analysis\:__ With this set up we can assess the choices made by individual animal in the Y maze over the course of the experiment. We can compare different types of the behaviors expressed by the animals in the maze (total number of occurrence and each type of behaviour). 
-- __Illustration:__ boxplots and data plots per group.  
-- __Definition of behaviors:__ 

* SAR: Spontaneous Arm Alternation.  
* SAP: Same Arm Return.  
* AAR: Alternate Arm Return.  

### Experimental conditions

2 Cohorts of mice:

LOG DATA: _No Crash of the system, all data can be used_

-> all data can be used    

Path to all Raw data files: `~\6. Data from Behavioral Test\Ymaze SPA`  

2 groups:  

`1_YmazeSPA_list.xlsx`    
`2_YmazeSPA_list.xlsx`   

The analysis of the data is done in this Rmd file directly.  

Path to Report: `~\6. Data from Behavioral Test\Ymaze SPA` 

### Data Quality:  
->All data can be used. 

```{r data_loading}

# Empty global environment
rm(list = ls())

### 1.0 LOAD IN DATA ----------------------------------------------------------
# load data
file_path <- "~/6. Data from Behavioral Tests/Ymaze SPA/data/"

raw_data_file_c1 <- "1_YmazeSPA_list_ns.xls"
raw_data_file_c2 <- "2_YmazeSPA_list_ns.xls"

data_c1 <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file_c1,sep=""))
data_c2 <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file_c2,sep=""))

# combine all groups to create a single data frame 
raw_data <- rbind(data_c1, data_c2)  

# lookup
file_path_lookup <- "~/6. Data from Behavioral Tests/"

# load lookup data files
lookup_file <- "lookup.xlsx"

# read lookup data files
lookup <- read_excel(paste(file_path_lookup,lookup_file,sep=""))
#names(lookup)[names(lookup) == 'No.'] <- 'Animal ID'

# combine data with lookup
data <- full_join(raw_data,lookup, by= "Animal ID")

# get list of groups without NAs
list_of_groups <- sort(na.omit(unique(data$Group)), decreasing = T)

# select columns of interest
data <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(SAP, `SAP%`, SAR, `SAR%`, AAR, `AAR%`, Group, `Animal ID`, Sex, cohort) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(Group, levels = list_of_groups),
         sex = factor(Sex),
         cohort = factor(cohort))

#lapply(data,class)

```

\newpage

### Results

#### Cohorts combined

```{r fig1a, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 12, fig.align='center'}

## SAP
#stats fig1a
stat_1a <- data %>%
  wilcox_test(SAP ~ group,exact=FALSE) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%     #  p.signif
  add_xy_position(x = "group") 

# plot fig1a
pl_1a <- data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=group, y=SAP, color = group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(position=position_jitter(w=0.2, h=0.2)) +
#  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20)) +  
  labs(x="",y="Spontaneous Alternation (no)", title = "Spontaneous Alternation") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 0) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_1a, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_1a 

################################# 
#stats fig1b
stat_1b <- data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  wilcox_test(SAP ~ sex,exact=FALSE) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%
```

__Figure 1.__ Ymaze Spontaneous Alternation Performance. Spontaneous Alternation Count between groups (A) and between gender within group (B), Spontaneous Alternation Percentage between groups (C) and between gender within group (D), Same Arm Return Count between groups (E) and between gender within group (F), Same Arm Return Percentage between groups (G) and between gender within group (H), Alternate Arm Return Count between groups (I) and between gender within group (J), Alternate Arm Return Percentage between groups (K) and between gender within group (L). 

__Statistics for Figure 1 (between groups)__

```{r stat1, echo=F}

stat_1a$Fig <- "fig1a"
stat_1c$Fig <- "fig1c"
stat_1e$Fig <- "fig1e"
stat_1g$Fig <- "fig1g"
stat_1i$Fig <- "fig1i"
stat_1k$Fig <- "fig1k"

stat_1 <- rbind(stat_1a,stat_1c,stat_1e,stat_1g,stat_1i,stat_1k)

#create a tibble to collect all stats
stat_1 %>%
  dplyr::select(-y.position,-groups,-xmin,-xmax) %>%
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position","scale_down"))

```

```{r fig2a, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 12, fig.align='center'}
  add_xy_position(x = "group") 

# plot fig2e
pl_2e <- data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=group, y=AAR, color = cohort)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(position=position_jitter(w=0.2, h=0.2)) +
#  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-2,15)) +   
  labs(x="",y="Alternate Arm Return (no)", title = "Alternate Arm Return") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text() +
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y=1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) +     
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_2e, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_2e

#################################
## AAR%
#stats fig2f
stat_2f <- data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  wilcox_test(`AAR%` ~ cohort,exact=FALSE) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "group") 

# plot fig2f
pl_2f <- data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=group, y=`AAR%`, color = cohort)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(position=position_jitter(w=0.2, h=0.2)) +
#  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-2,55)) +   
  labs(x="",y="Alternate Arm Return (%)", title = "Alternate Arm Return") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text() +
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y=5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) +     
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_2f, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)
 
#pl_2f

################################# 

# Create a grid with plots
fig2 <- ggarrange(pl_2a, pl_2b, pl_2c, pl_2d, pl_2e, pl_2f,
                               ncol = 2, nrow = 3,
                               common.legend = FALSE, legend = "bottom", labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"))

fig2

```

__Figure 2.__ Ymaze Spontaneous Alternation Performance Cohorts Comparision. Spontaneous Alternation Count between cohorts (A), Spontaneous Alternation Percentage between cohorts (B), Same Arm Return Count between cohorts (C), Same Arm Return Percentage between cohorts (D), Alternate Arm Return Count between cohorts (E), Alternate Arm Return Percentage between cohorts (F).
